title: Extract fieldwork::delivery module with DB queries
description:
Now that fieldwork owns the schema, extract the delivery queue worker WITH persistence into fieldwork. The retry schedule and circuit breaker are already extracted (fieldwork::retry, fieldwork::circuit_breaker). This adds the queue worker and DB operations.

Source: GJ delivery.rs (full file minus retry/circuit_breaker already extracted), BS delivery.rs.

Public API:
1. Queue operations (uses fieldwork::db::Pool):
   - enqueue_delivery(pool, target_inbox: &str, sender_persona_id: &str, activity_json: &Value) -> Result<i64> — INSERT into delivery_queue
   - fetch_pending_batch(pool, limit: i32) -> Result<Vec<DeliveryJob>> — SELECT WHERE delivered_at IS NULL AND dead_at IS NULL AND next_attempt_at <= now
   - mark_delivered(pool, id: i64) -> Result<()>
   - mark_dead(pool, id: i64) -> Result<()>
   - schedule_retry(pool, id: i64, attempt: i32, error: &str) -> Result<()> — uses fieldwork::retry::delay_ms()
   - DeliveryJob struct matching canonical delivery_queue table

2. Worker (async, uses above + circuit breaker):
   - deliver_one(client: &reqwest::Client, job: &DeliveryJob, sign_fn: impl Fn) -> Result<()> — POST to inbox with HTTP signature, handle 410 Gone
   - run_delivery_loop(pool, client, sign_fn, circuit_breaker) — poll-based worker loop with semaphore concurrency control

Deps: reqwest, cavage-httpsig, sqlx via db features, tokio.

Design: sign_fn callback lets each project provide its own key lookup (persona private key from DB). The worker doesn't need to know about persona/user models beyond sender_persona_id.

Note: 410 Gone handling differs between BS and GJ/SH. BS removes the follower immediately. GJ/SH mark delivery dead but don't remove followers. Make Gone handling configurable via callback or enum.
close_reason: DB persistence modules extracted. media_db (6 tests), cards_db (10 tests), delivery_db (8 tests). All 158 fieldwork tests pass.
